changes: Added recent screen frames to the chat paperclip menu, so you can attach what you were looking at as an image

Fixed "what's on my screen?" asked from Omi's own window answering with Omi's interface — it now answers from the most recent frame of the app you were actually in, and when you switch into your first real app, the on-screen prompt includes that frame for you
Improved chat responsiveness with reusable Markdown rendering and a more compact composer with consistent Send and Stop controls
Added image pasting to the chat composer, so ⌘V with a screenshot or a copied file stages it as an attachment
